notes:
Updates only with the admin's approval (LEVEL7 CAD MTM Admin 1.3.0)

The program reads the version the admin offers (level7-<program>/latest.json in the public releases repository),
checks his signature over the installer's fingerprint and size with the admin's key built in (the same key as the
sign-in: licence.approved_setup), downloads it from the releases repository only, checks its SHA-256 and installs it.
An offer not signed by him (another key, another file, version or program, another host) is refused; nothing is
offered from this program's own (private) repository any more.

ar: التحديثات تصل فقط بعد اعتماد المدير من برنامج المدير
